DeterminationBasis: T16-013 directly requires a conformance claim to identify the exact standard version and fails when the standard version is omitted, materially ambiguous, transferable to another version, or where more than one materially different version could support the wording. This directly covers CONF-003.

T16-013 governs conformance claims generally and requires the exact standard version to be identified in the claim. A public conformance claim is a conformance claim, so the broader T16-013 rule already requires version identification at claim level without waiting for the narrower condition that version differences materially alter requirements. WORD-006 therefore does not require a separate public-version test.
